name_zh: 阿连德/智利/社会主义/选举/政变/自杀/萨尔瓦多/拉莫内达
description_zh: 萨尔瓦多·阿连德 (1908-1973) 智利总统 (1970-1973) 民选社会主义者，推行民主途径向社会主义过渡，通过国家化改革推动智利现代化，因1973 年军事政变被推翻，死于政变过程中，成为拉美社会主义革命的象征。
description_en: Salvador Allende (1908-1973) Chilean President (1970-1973) elected socialist, implemented democratic path to socialism transition, promoted state ownership reforms to advance Chilean modernization, overthrown by 1973 military coup, died in coup, became Latin American socialism revolution symbol.
reason_zh: 阿连德代表拉美民选社会主义者如何通过民主途径实现社会主义，如何国家化改革推动国家现代化，以及军事政变如何影响拉美民主进程，体现了拉美政治转型的复杂性。
reason_en: Allende represents how Latin American elected socialists achieve socialism through democratic means, promote state ownership to advance national modernization, and military coup influences Latin American democratic process, embodies Latin American political transformation complexity.
